entries.en: He was in a temper after finding paint on his new shoes.
entries.zh: 发现新鞋上沾了油漆后，他很生气。

entries.en: Losing both sets of keys left us in a tight spot.
entries.zh: 两套钥匙都丢了，让我们陷入了困境。

entries.en: The room was dark, cramped and, in a word, unsuitable.
entries.zh: 那个房间又暗又挤，总之，不合适。

entries.en: The garden project remained in abeyance while we searched for another site.
entries.zh: 我们寻找另一处场地期间，花园项目一直暂时搁置着。

entries.en: For once, the two designers were entirely in accord.
entries.zh: 难得有一次，那两位设计师的意见完全一致。

entries.en: Her recollection was in accord with the dates in my diary.
entries.zh: 她的回忆与我日记中的日期一致。

entries.en: We arranged the chairs in accordance with the host's instructions.
entries.zh: 我们依照主人的指示摆放了椅子。

entries.en: The door looked locked, but in actual fact it was merely stuck.
entries.zh: 那扇门看起来锁住了，但事实上只是卡住了。

entries.en: He sounded cheerful but was, in actuality, deeply worried about the move.
entries.zh: 他听上去很愉快，实际上却对搬家深感担忧。

entries.en: The piano arrived in advance of the rest of our furniture.
entries.zh: 钢琴比我们的其余家具先到了。

entries.en: They held a book sale in aid of repairs to the village hall.
entries.zh: 他们举行了图书义卖，为修缮村礼堂筹款。

entries.en: That is, in all conscience, more work than one person can manage.
entries.zh: 公平地说，那些工作已经超出一个人所能应付的量了。

entries.en: We cleared the spare room in anticipation of our friends' arrival.
entries.zh: 预料到朋友们要来，我们清理了备用房间。

entries.en: After a month without work, he was in arrears with the rent.
entries.zh: 失业一个月后，他拖欠了房租。

entries.en: The library arranged the exhibition in association with a local history group.
entries.zh: 图书馆与当地一个历史小组联合举办了展览。

entries.en: Several former pupils were in attendance at the small reunion.
entries.zh: 几位往届学生出席了那场小型聚会。

entries.en: The gate was in bad repair and scraped the path whenever it opened.
entries.zh: 那扇大门失修了，每次打开都会刮到小路。

entries.en: Her joke about the ruined wedding cake was in bad taste.
entries.zh: 她拿毁坏的婚礼蛋糕开玩笑，很不得体。

entries.en: I was already in bed when the doorbell rang.
entries.zh: 门铃响时，我已经在床上了。

entries.en: The promised delivery date was there in black and white.
entries.zh: 承诺的交货日期就在那里白纸黑字地写着。

entries.en: The apple trees were in bloom when we returned to the farm.
entries.zh: 我们回到农场时，苹果树正在开花。

entries.en: Someone took the bicycle from our front garden in broad daylight.
entries.zh: 有人在大白天从我们屋前的花园里偷走了自行车。

entries.en: The branches were already in bud when we moved into the cottage.
entries.zh: 我们搬进小屋时，那些枝条已经长出了芽。

entries.en: In the story, the caretaker is in cahoots with the jewel thief.
entries.zh: 在那个故事里，看门人与珠宝窃贼相勾结。

entries.en: Send the parcel to me in care of the hostel manager.
entries.zh: 把包裹寄给我，由青年旅舍经理转交。

entries.en: Keep a spare pencil nearby in case of a broken point.
entries.zh: 在手边备一支铅笔，以防笔尖折断。

entries.en: With both owners away, Marta was in charge of the shop.
entries.zh: 两位店主都不在，玛尔塔负责照看商店。

entries.en: A few of those old coins were still in circulation.
entries.zh: 那种旧硬币仍有少量在流通。

entries.en: With the house paid for and a steady income, they were in clover.
entries.zh: 房款已经付清，又有稳定收入，他们的生活十分优裕。

entries.en: The captain remained in command throughout the difficult crossing.
entries.zh: 在整个艰难的渡航过程中，船长一直担任指挥。

entries.en: She explored the ruined abbey in company with two old friends.
entries.zh: 她和两位老朋友一起探访了那座修道院遗址。

entries.en: Our kitchen seems enormous in comparison to the one in our previous flat.
entries.zh: 与我们上一套公寓的厨房相比，现在的厨房显得很大。

entries.en: This cloth feels rough in comparison with the blue sample.
entries.zh: 与蓝色样布相比，这块布摸起来很粗糙。

entries.en: The school ran the concert in conjunction with the village choir.
entries.zh: 学校与村里的合唱团合作举办了那场音乐会。

entries.en: I received another letter in connection with the missing suitcase.
entries.zh: 我又收到了一封与那只丢失的行李箱有关的信。

entries.en: The roof leaked all night; in consequence, the bedroom carpet was soaked.
entries.zh: 屋顶漏了一夜，结果卧室的地毯都湿透了。

entries.en: The wet paint had been in contact with her sleeve.
entries.zh: 湿油漆曾接触到她的衣袖。

entries.en: My room faces a busy road; hers, in contrast, overlooks a quiet garden.
entries.zh: 我的房间朝着繁忙的街道；相比之下，她的房间俯瞰一座安静的花园。

entries.en: In contrast to his cheerful letters, his voice sounded tired.
entries.zh: 与他欢快的来信形成对照的是，他的声音听起来很疲惫。

entries.en: Attendance at the evening club had been in decline for months.
entries.zh: 晚间俱乐部的出席人数几个月来一直在下降。

entries.en: In default of a better suggestion, we returned to the original plan.
entries.zh: 由于没有更好的建议，我们又采用了原来的计划。

entries.en: We discussed the ending in depth after the other readers left.
entries.zh: 其他读者离开后，我们深入讨论了结尾。

entries.en: The little shop was in difficulty after losing its largest customer.
entries.zh: 那家小店失去最大的一位客户后，陷入了困境。

entries.en: The idea was still in embryo when she first described it to me.
entries.zh: 她第一次向我介绍那个想法时，它还处于萌芽阶段。

entries.en: The caretaker had sent the spare key to us in error.
entries.zh: 看门人误把备用钥匙寄给了我们。

entries.en: He offered his old camera in exchange for my guitar.
entries.zh: 他提出用自己的旧相机换我的吉他。

entries.en: When we voted on the new timetable, only three people were in favour.
entries.zh: 我们就新时间表达决时，只有三个人赞成。

entries.en: She spoke in favour of keeping the playground open at weekends.
entries.zh: 她发言支持周末继续开放游乐场。

entries.en: He hid the cracked bowl in fear of the owner's anger.
entries.zh: 他担心主人生气，把那只裂了的碗藏了起来。

entries.en: Rosa arrived in fine fettle, ready to dance all evening.
entries.zh: 罗莎精神饱满地来了，准备跳一整晚的舞。

entries.en: The old printer worked in fits and starts throughout the afternoon.
entries.zh: 那台旧打印机整个下午都断断续续地运转着。

entries.en: By the time we reached the lane, the empty shed was in flames.
entries.zh: 我们赶到小巷时，那座空棚屋已经燃烧起来了。

entries.en: The river was in flood, so we abandoned our walk along its banks.
entries.zh: 河水泛滥了，所以我们放弃了沿河散步。

entries.en: Only the plants beside the sunny wall were in flower.
entries.zh: 只有向阳墙边的那些植物开着花。

entries.en: Her face was in focus, but the hills behind her were blurred.
entries.zh: 她的脸很清晰，但身后的山丘却模糊了。

entries.en: A yellow van stopped in front of our gate.
entries.zh: 一辆黄色厢式货车停在了我们的大门前。

entries.en: The hounds were in full cry as they crossed the field.
entries.zh: 猎犬们穿过田野时，正吠叫着追猎。

entries.en: In future, please leave the muddy boots by the back door.
entries.zh: 往后，请把沾泥的靴子放在后门旁。

entries.en: I lent him the tools in good faith and expected them back.
entries.zh: 我诚心把工具借给了他，并期待他归还。

entries.en: Although the cottage was old, its roof was in good repair.
entries.zh: 那间小屋虽然很旧，屋顶却修缮良好。

entries.en: The suitcase was battered, but the violin inside was in good shape.
entries.zh: 行李箱磕碰得很厉害，但里面的小提琴状况良好。

entries.en: Extra chairs were in great demand as more guests arrived.
entries.zh: 随着更多客人到来，大家急需额外的椅子。

entries.en: The farmer noticed that the mare was in heat.
entries.zh: 农场主注意到那匹母马发情了。

entries.en: His watch was still in hock when the unexpected cheque arrived.
entries.zh: 那张意外的支票送到时，他的手表还在当铺里。

entries.en: They planted a tree in honour of their former teacher.
entries.zh: 他们种了一棵树，纪念以前的老师。

entries.en: The simple wooden benches were in keeping with the quiet setting.
entries.zh: 朴素的木长椅与那处宁静的环境很协调。

entries.en: The novel's mayor was secretly in league with the smugglers.
entries.zh: 小说中的市长暗中与走私者勾结。

entries.en: She accepted a painting in lieu of the money he owed her.
entries.zh: 她接受了一幅画，抵偿他欠她的钱。

entries.en: After her successful audition, she was in line for a leading role.
entries.zh: 试镜成功后，她有望得到一个主角的角色。

entries.en: We shortened the speech in line with the organiser's request.
entries.zh: 我们按照组织者的要求缩短了演讲。

entries.en: She realised she was in love with the quiet bookseller.
entries.zh: 她意识到自己爱上了那位安静的书商。

entries.en: He built the whole harbour in miniature on his kitchen table.
entries.zh: 他在厨房桌上制作了整个港口的缩小模型。

entries.en: The box was torn, but the toy inside was in mint condition.
entries.zh: 盒子破了，但里面的玩具完好如新。

entries.en: She explained in mitigation that she had received the instructions too late.
entries.zh: 她为减轻自己的责任解释说，她收到指示时已经太迟了。

entries.en: Still in mourning, she wore a black armband to the gathering.
entries.zh: 她仍在服丧，戴着黑纱袖章参加了聚会。

entries.en: In my opinion, the quieter room would suit us better.
entries.zh: 依我看来，那个更安静的房间会更适合我们。

entries.en: The neighbours collected blankets for families in need.
entries.zh: 邻居们为有困难的家庭收集了毯子。

entries.en: Anyone in need of a seat could rest in the kitchen.
entries.zh: 任何需要座位的人都可以到厨房休息。

entries.en: She told us in no uncertain terms to leave her garden alone.
entries.zh: 她用十分明确的措辞告诉我们，不要动她的花园。

entries.en: The missing page was in no way her fault.
entries.zh: 丢失书页绝不是她的过错。

entries.en: This little device is a radio and a torch in one.
entries.zh: 这个小装置把收音机和手电筒合为一体。

entries.en: The mirror arrived in one piece despite its flimsy wrapping.
entries.zh: 尽管包装很单薄，镜子还是完好无损地送到了。

entries.en: We rehearsed the songs in parallel with the dancers' preparations.
entries.zh: 我们排练歌曲的同时，舞者们也在做准备。

entries.en: The student drew the long corridor in perspective.
entries.zh: 那名学生用透视画法画出了长长的走廊。

entries.en: The two signals were in phase on the classroom display.
entries.zh: 教室显示屏上的两个信号处于同相状态。

entries.en: There were strawberries in plenty, but no bowls to serve them in.
entries.zh: 草莓多得很，却没有盛草莓的碗。

entries.en: The advertisement beside the memorial seemed in poor taste.
entries.zh: 纪念碑旁的那则广告显得很不得体。

entries.en: The latch looked simple, but in practice it was difficult to open.
entries.zh: 那个门闩看起来简单，实际上却很难打开。

entries.en: I was surprised that her earliest novel was still in print.
entries.zh: 她最早的那部小说仍在印行销售，这让我很意外。

entries.en: The rehearsal was still in progress when we entered the hall.
entries.zh: 我们走进礼堂时，排练还在进行。

entries.en: Her calm explanation helped me see the setback in proportion.
entries.zh: 她平静的解释帮助我恰当地衡量那次挫折的严重程度。

entries.en: Each drawing was enlarged in proportion to its original dimensions.
entries.zh: 每幅画都按其原有尺寸的比例放大了。

entries.en: We are in receipt of your letter about the damaged parcel.
entries.zh: 我们已收到您关于包裹受损的来信。

entries.en: They gave him a silver pen in recognition of his years of service.
entries.zh: 他们赠给他一支银笔，酬谢他多年的服务。

entries.en: After the family business closed, they lived in reduced circumstances.
entries.zh: 家族企业关闭后，他们的生活境况变差了。

entries.en: She asked one final question in reference to the missing photographs.
entries.zh: 她最后又问了一个关于那些丢失照片的问题。

entries.en: I have nothing to add in regard to the proposed timetable.
entries.zh: 关于拟议的时间表，我没有什么要补充的。

entries.en: The teacher received several questions in relation to the school trip.
entries.zh: 老师收到了几个有关学校出游的问题。

entries.en: We kept two clean blankets in reserve for unexpected visitors.
entries.zh: 我们留了两条干净的毯子，供意外来访的客人使用。

entries.en: The artist was in residence at the college throughout the winter.
entries.zh: 那位艺术家整个冬天都住在学院里。

entries.en: The letter raised two concerns in respect of the building work.
entries.zh: 那封信提出了关于建筑工程的两个担忧。

entries.en: In retrospect, buying the larger table was a mistake.
entries.zh: 回顾起来，买那张较大的桌子是个错误。

entries.en: She baked us a cake in return for repairing her bicycle.
entries.zh: 她烤了一个蛋糕给我们，报答我们帮她修自行车。

entries.en: We read the letters in reverse, starting with the most recent.
entries.zh: 我们倒着读那些信，从最近的一封开始。

entries.en: The old mill stood in ruins beside the narrow stream.
entries.zh: 旧磨坊在那条狭窄的溪流旁，已经成为废墟。

entries.en: The market stall sold only fruit that was in season.
entries.zh: 那个市场摊位只卖当令的水果。

entries.en: One of the old lifts was still in service.
entries.zh: 其中一部旧电梯仍在使用中。

entries.en: She wanted to get in shape before the long walking holiday.
entries.zh: 她想在长途徒步度假之前把身体状态调整好。

entries.en: Dry socks were in short supply after three days of rain.
entries.zh: 连下三天雨后，干袜子不够用了。

entries.en: We could see the birds in silhouette against the evening sky.
entries.zh: 映着傍晚的天空，我们能看见鸟儿的剪影。

entries.en: The stream was in spate and covered the stepping stones.
entries.zh: 溪水猛涨，淹没了踏脚石。

entries.en: I cannot join the walk, but I will be with you in spirit.
entries.zh: 我无法参加徒步，但会在精神上与你们同行。

entries.en: We finished painting the fence in spite of the cold wind.
entries.zh: 尽管刮着寒风，我们还是把篱笆刷完了。

entries.en: The children marched in step across the playground.
entries.zh: 孩子们步调一致地走过操场。

entries.en: His impression of the grumpy neighbour had us all in stitches.
entries.zh: 他模仿那位脾气暴躁的邻居，把我们都逗得笑个不停。

entries.en: A pleasant surprise was in store for the returning travellers.
entries.zh: 一个惊喜正等着归来的旅客们。

entries.en: In sum, the journey cost less but took much longer.
entries.zh: 总之，那趟旅程花钱更少，但耗时长得多。

entries.en: In terms of storage space, the smaller desk was surprisingly useful.
entries.zh: 在储物空间方面，那张较小的书桌出人意料地实用。

entries.en: The hall may be unavailable; in that event, we will meet outside.
entries.zh: 礼堂可能无法使用；如果那样，我们就在外面见面。

entries.en: The guard caught the thief in the act of cutting the lock.
entries.zh: 警卫当场抓住了正在剪锁的窃贼。

entries.en: The younger artists were in the ascendant at that year's exhibition.
entries.zh: 在那一年的展览中，年轻艺术家们正呈上升势头。

entries.en: He thought the prize was in the bag until the final round.
entries.zh: 直到最后一轮之前，他都认为那个奖已经十拿九稳了。

entries.en: The little café was finally in the black by autumn.
entries.zh: 到秋天，那家小咖啡馆终于开始盈利了。

entries.en: With the final scene in the can, the crew packed away their equipment.
entries.zh: 最后一场戏拍完后，摄制组收起了设备。

entries.en: Another move was not in the cards for our family that year.
entries.zh: 那一年，我们家不大可能再搬一次家。

entries.en: The missing receipt turned up, leaving the cashier in the clear.
entries.zh: 那张丢失的收据找到了，收银员因此洗清了嫌疑。

entries.en: We found the missing ring in the course of cleaning the kitchen.
entries.zh: 我们在清理厨房的过程中找到了那枚丢失的戒指。

entries.en: In the course of time, the two separate gardens became one.
entries.zh: 随着时间推移，那两座原本分开的花园合成了一座。

entries.en: He was in the doghouse after forgetting their anniversary again.
entries.zh: 他又忘了他们的周年纪念日，因此惹得对方很不高兴。

entries.en: She was in the employ of a bookseller when we first met.
entries.zh: 我们初次见面时，她受雇于一位书商。

entries.en: We expected a difficult crossing; in the event, the sea was calm.
entries.zh: 我们原以为渡海会很艰难，结果海面很平静。

entries.en: In the event of rain, the picnic will move indoors.
entries.zh: 如果下雨，野餐将改在室内举行。

entries.en: Their reply was discourteous in the extreme and surprised everyone.
entries.zh: 他们的回复极其无礼，令所有人都感到意外。

entries.en: She kept the little shop open in the face of mounting difficulties.
entries.zh: 面对越来越多的困难，她仍坚持经营那家小店。

entries.en: After years in the fast lane, he wanted a quiet job near home.
entries.zh: 过了多年紧张忙碌的生活后，他想在家附近找份清静的工作。

entries.en: The soldiers had been in the field for several weeks.
entries.zh: 那些士兵已经在外作战数周了。

entries.en: In the final analysis, we simply wanted different things.
entries.zh: 归根到底，我们想要的东西就是不同。

entries.en: Please contact the caretaker in the first instance about the broken window.
entries.zh: 关于那扇坏了的窗户，请先联系管理员。

entries.en: We hope to turn the spare room into a studio in the future.
entries.zh: 我们希望将来把备用房间改成工作室。

entries.en: He was in the habit of leaving coins on the kitchen shelf.
entries.zh: 他习惯把硬币放在厨房架子上。

entries.en: We returned to the beach in the hope of finding her necklace.
entries.zh: 我们回到海滩，希望能找到她的项链。

entries.en: We postponed the argument in the interests of family harmony.
entries.zh: 为了家庭和睦，我们暂缓了那场争论。

entries.en: The stage manager was in the know but refused to reveal the surprise.
entries.zh: 舞台监督了解内幕，但拒绝透露那个惊喜。

entries.term: in the lap of the gods
entries.en: With the application submitted, the outcome was in the lap of the gods.
entries.zh: 申请交上去后，结果就只能听天由命了。

entries.en: In the last analysis, a larger house would not solve their disagreement.
entries.zh: 归根到底，一栋更大的房子也解决不了他们的分歧。

entries.en: We changed our route in the light of the weather forecast.
entries.zh: 我们根据天气预报改变了路线。

entries.en: The officer lost her notebook in the line of duty.
entries.zh: 那名警官在执行公务时丢了笔记本。

entries.en: Repairing the boots should cost less in the long run.
entries.zh: 从长远看，修补这双靴子应该更省钱。

entries.en: In the long term, we hope to grow all our own vegetables.
entries.zh: 从长远看，我们希望自己种植所需的全部蔬菜。

entries.en: The exhibition was three years in the making.
entries.zh: 那场展览筹备了三年才成形。

entries.en: Someone had left a single chair in the middle of the room.
entries.zh: 有人在房间正中央放了一把椅子。

entries.en: She found a quiet moment in the midst of the celebrations.
entries.zh: 她在庆祝活动中找到了片刻的宁静。

entries.en: After selling the painting, he was suddenly in the money.
entries.zh: 卖掉那幅画后，他一下子手头富裕了。

entries.en: They made the donation in the name of their former teacher.
entries.zh: 他们以以前那位老师的名义捐了款。

entries.en: Her visit was in the nature of an apology.
entries.zh: 她的来访带有道歉的性质。

entries.en: In the nature of things, new neighbours need time to become friends.
entries.zh: 新邻居需要时间才能成为朋友，这是很自然的。

entries.en: They hope to open a second workshop in the near future.
entries.zh: 他们希望在不久的将来开设第二间作坊。

entries.en: With another wedding in the offing, the family began saving again.
entries.zh: 眼看又有一场婚礼将至，全家又开始攒钱了。

entries.en: We ate in the open beside a small stream.
entries.zh: 我们在一条小溪旁露天用餐。

entries.en: The letters were filed in the order of their arrival.
entries.zh: 那些信按送到的先后顺序归档了。

entries.en: In the detective story, the driver was in the pay of the smugglers.
entries.zh: 在那部侦探小说里，司机受雇于走私者。

entries.en: The village sent a representative in the person of its oldest resident.
entries.zh: 村里派出代表，由村中最年长的居民担任。

entries.en: The daily calls kept her in the picture while she was away.
entries.zh: 她不在期间，每天的电话让她一直了解情况。

entries.en: He looked in the pink when he joined us for lunch.
entries.zh: 他来和我们一起吃午饭时，看起来身体很好。

entries.en: Two more exhibitions were in the pipeline at the small gallery.
entries.zh: 那家小画廊还在筹备另外两场展览。

entries.en: I found the button in the process of emptying my bag.
entries.zh: 我清空包里的东西时找到了那颗纽扣。

entries.en: The club remained in the red despite its crowded summer concerts.
entries.zh: 尽管夏季音乐会观众很多，俱乐部仍处于亏损状态。

entries.en: They searched for a campsite in the region of the lake.
entries.zh: 他们在湖的附近寻找露营地。

entries.en: She knew she was in the right but apologised for shouting.
entries.zh: 她知道自己有理，但还是为大喊大叫道了歉。

entries.en: With a new director in the saddle, rehearsals became more orderly.
entries.zh: 新导演上任后，排练变得更有条理了。

entries.en: They rented a cottage in the shadow of the old castle.
entries.zh: 他们在那座古堡的阴影下租了一间小屋。

entries.en: Help arrived in the shape of a neighbour with a ladder.
entries.zh: 援助来了，是一位带着梯子的邻居。

entries.en: The smaller van would be cheaper in the short run.
entries.zh: 从短期看，那辆较小的厢式货车会更省钱。

entries.en: We can share the spare room in the short term.
entries.zh: 短期内，我们可以共用备用房间。

entries.en: We were in the soup after locking both keys inside the car.
entries.zh: 把两把钥匙都锁在车里后，我们陷入了困境。

entries.en: The young violinist found herself in the spotlight after the concert.
entries.zh: 音乐会后，那位年轻的小提琴手发现自己成为了公众关注的中心。

entries.en: They continued repairing the hall in the teeth of fierce opposition.
entries.zh: 尽管遭到强烈反对，他们仍继续修缮礼堂。

entries.en: The telephone rang in the thick of our argument.
entries.zh: 我们争论得最激烈时，电话响了。

entries.en: She was in the throes of rewriting the ending when I called.
entries.zh: 我打电话时，她正苦苦地重写结尾。

entries.en: The smaller boat followed in the wake of the fishing vessel.
entries.zh: 那条较小的船紧跟在渔船后面。

entries.en: We had little in the way of furniture when we first moved in.
entries.zh: 我们刚搬进去时，家具很少。

entries.en: With a change of ownership in the wind, the staff felt unsettled.
entries.zh: 店铺即将易主，员工们感到不安。

entries.en: The next singer waited in the wings with a glass of water.
entries.zh: 下一位歌手带着一杯水，在舞台侧面等候。

entries.en: A new children's concert was already in the works.
entries.zh: 一场新的儿童音乐会已经在筹备中了。

entries.en: She wanted to visit every country in the world.
entries.zh: 她想走遍世界上的每一个国家。

entries.en: He admitted he was in the wrong and replaced the broken bowl.
entries.zh: 他承认自己有错，并赔了一只碗。

entries.en: In this connection, her earlier letter is worth reading again.
entries.zh: 在这一点上，她先前的那封信值得重读。

entries.en: We reached the village in time for the evening concert.
entries.zh: 我们及时赶到村里，赶上了晚间音乐会。

entries.en: The parcel contained twelve books in total, including two dictionaries.
entries.zh: 包裹里总共有十二本书，包括两本词典。
